description: Primitive library: cube, sphere, cylinder and cone render closed, lit, with their triangle structure
expected: Four closed primitives; counts printed from the generators
observed: Cube (one diagonal per face), sphere (latitude/longitude triangles), cylinder (36 side quads + fan caps) and cone (fan to the apex) all closed and lit; labels show 24/12, 614/1224, 146/144 and 109/72 vertices/triangles

description: Thermal view: hot rover, warm bunker vents/door/generator and floodlight, cold vegetation
expected: Rover brightest, bunker details warm, trees and ground dark
observed: Rover under a TGT LOCK bracket in orange/white; bunker vents, slits and door warm; watchtower floodlight warm; pines and ground dark purple; UAV feed (320x240) shows the rover hot at the centre

description: UAV camera (computer vision) keeps the target centred while tracking
expected: Rover near the image centre, HUD mode TRACK
observed: Through the UAV camera the rover's motor box is white-hot near the image centre; HUD reads TRACK

description: Rover hides under tree cover; UAV loses it and switches to REACQUIRE
expected: Rover HIDDEN, UAV REACQUIRE, LAST KNOWN marker, 0 blobs in the feed
observed: At t = 52 s HUD reads REACQUIRE and ROVER HIDDEN; the LAST KNOWN bracket sits on a spruce crown that covers the rover; the UAV feed shows 0 blobs

description: Z-buffer: disabling the depth test breaks hidden-surface removal
expected: The hidden rover is drawn on top of the crown that covers it
observed: Same frame with Z-TEST OFF: the rover (hot) is painted over the spruce crown that hides it in V04

description: Depth buffer visualisation
expected: Linearised depth: near white, far dark
observed: Grey ramp from the near watchtower and trees (light) to the distant hills (dark)

description: Hidden-line wireframe shows only visible edges
expected: Edges drawn over offset solids; occluded edges removed
observed: Terrain rings, fence, pines and trees drawn as visible edges only; the bunker hides the ground edges behind it

description: X-ray wireframe shows overlapping (hidden) edges, colour-coded by primitive
expected: All edges visible; cube cyan, sphere magenta, cylinder amber, cone green
observed: Back edges visible through solids; bunker/crates cyan, canopies/hills magenta, posts/wires amber, pine whorls green

description: Primitive diagnostic + explode separates composites into components
expected: Composite parts pushed apart, colours match the legend
observed: Bunker, UAV and rover components separated along their offsets; colours match the four-primitive legend

description: Flat shading on the bunker
expected: Faceted dome and turret ring
observed: Dome and turret ring show individual facets; walls lit uniformly per face; soft moon shadows and warm door lamp on the facade

description: Shading override: same bunker in Gouraud / Phong
expected: Dome facets disappear
observed: Dome facets smooth out under Gouraud and Phong; large flat walls look almost identical in all three (one normal per face either way)

description: Three main lights plus practical lights act together
expected: Moonlight + shadows, red beacon, searchlight pool, warm lamps
observed: Cool moonlight with long shadows, pulsing red beacon, UAV searchlight pool, sodium lamp posts, door lamp, fire barrel and floodlight all visible

description: Hierarchical searchlight: local axes of UAV body, gimbal yaw and gimbal pitch
expected: Axis triads at each node; beam follows the pitch axis
observed: RGB axis triads drawn at the body and both gimbal nodes; the lamp points along the pitch node's axis

description: MicroMouse flood field
expected: Goal cells (cyan) out of the UAV's sight, values rising away from them
observed: With the UAV low (4.4 m) in REACQUIRE most free cells are hidden by the forest (cyan); free cells are absent under buildings and trees

description: Realistic ground: turf, tyre ruts, gravel, pebble creek bed, grass tufts
expected: Distinct ground materials in the right places; no hard texel edges
observed: Two curved tyre ruts along the track with gravel, dark turf with clumped grass tufts, pebbled wet creek bed; track edges smooth

description: v1 renderer vs v2 pipeline, same camera
expected: Same framing; v2 adds shadows, PBR, lights, fog, grading
observed: Identical framing; v1 is flat and dark, v2 shows moon shadows, warm practical lights, ground materials, haze and bloom

description: Feature ablation: one feature off at a time
expected: Only the removed feature changes
observed: Without shadows the ground under trees and the bunker is evenly lit; without fog the far hills lose their haze; without bloom the beacon and lamps lose their glow; SSAO off is barely visible at this camera distance (contact darkening is small)

description: Volumetric searchlight shaft
expected: Visible light cone in the mist, cut by geometry
observed: The UAV's beam is a visible cone in the haze lighting a spruce and the ground under it

description: Ground-level view of the rover
expected: Rover, grass and IR sensors readable at ground level
observed: Rover under the watchtower platform in lit grass; its five IR line sensors glow red

description: Thermal palette switch (T): ironbow, white-hot, rainbow
expected: Same scene, three colour maps; main view, UAV feed and HOT/COLD bar switch together
observed: Identical frames rendered with ironbow, white-hot (grey ramp) and rainbow; the UAV feed inset and the colour bar change with the palette and the palette name is shown above the bar

description: Thermal footprints: the rover's tyres leave warm tracks that cool with time
expected: Twin warm tracks behind the rover, older parts of the path dimmer
observed: Two parallel warm tyre tracks lead to the rover; loops of its earlier path are visible and fainter the older they are

description: Rain in the visible view: lit streaks, wet ground with lamp reflections, overcast sky
expected: Streaks brighter near lamps and in the searchlight, glossy wet track reflecting the lamp, stars and moon hidden
observed: Rain streaks across the frame, brighter around the sodium lamp and inside the searchlight cone; the wet track shows the lamp's orange reflection along the ruts; clouds cover the sky and the moon is reduced to a faint disc; foliage has only a slight sheen

description: Rain in the thermal view: cooled ground, footprints stand out, no streaks
expected: Darker (cooler) ground, warm tracks and hot rover clearly visible, rain invisible to LWIR
observed: Ground and props are darker than in the dry thermal view; the rover's warm tyre tracks stand out in the UAV feed; no rain streaks appear in the thermal image
